description:
A forest walk to impressive views over Shuswap Lake high above Scotch Creek. The area was partially burnt in 2023 but the trail has been repaired in 2026.

The Scotch Creek Lookout:

This lovely 3.5 km round trip takes hikers, mountain bikers, and even snowshoers to an impressive viewpoint high above Scotch Creek. On a clear day Shuswap Lake and the highlands to the south, east and west are spread out in dramatic panoramas. Appropriate precautions for bears should be made, as wildlife is prevalent.

Hlina Loop Route:

Look for the route post sign at the northwest corner of the Scotch Creek Lookout trail. Look for orange blaze markers along the route.

For geo-referenced maps and information: https://shuswaptrails.com/trails/system/34/Scotch-Creek-Hlina/
directions:
Travel east through the North Shuswap community of Scotch Creek on the Squilax-Anglemont Rd to Leopold Road at the top of the hill. Driving up Leopold Road watch for trailhead arrows at each junction. Stay straight at the first junction past Allen Road (620 m) onto Scotch-Hlina FSR. At approx. 6.7 km from Leopold Rd, take the left fork to find the trailhead parking area another 200 m around the bend. Park here and begin your walk (or ride) continuing up the logging road until it meets the trail.

Trail head Location Lat 50?56'55.68"N, Long 119?25'40.27"W
title: South Scotch Creek Trails
